items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: For example with David you were doing an all Jerome Kern album with the Sure Thing. ... Yes.

ctx.x: We sit down and decide those things, that’s what we do.
For example with David you were doing an all Jerome Kern album with the Sure Thing.

You know with most of those dates at that time it was what can we afford, how big of an orchestra can I have. We’d mutually agree on the songs and you tried to get the nicest orchestra you could and try and get the best mixer you could and record in the best studios you could. That was really the name of the game.
